Package edu.cnu.mdi.mapping.shapefile

Class ShapeFeatureStyle

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.mapping.shapefile.ShapeFeatureStyle
public final class ShapeFeatureStyle extends Object
Configures the visual appearance of a ShapeFeatureRenderer layer.

ShapeFeatureStyle is a mutable configuration object intentionally designed for fluent construction at the call site. Unlike the immutable MapTheme, styles for individual layers are expected to be created once per layer and not shared or modified afterward.

Per-geometry-type defaults

The defaults are chosen so that a style can be used with any geometry type without explicit configuration, but callers will almost always want to set at least the stroke or fill color to match their data:

  • Fill color: null — polygons are not filled by default. Set via fillColor(Color) for lakes, land cover, etc.
  • Stroke color: Color.BLUE — a visible default for polylines such as rivers. Set via strokeColor(Color).
  • Stroke width: 1.0 pt.
  • Point radius: 3.0 screen pixels.
  • Point color: Color.RED.
  • Label field: null — no labels drawn by default.
  • Antialiasing: enabled.

Usage


 // Rivers — thin blue lines, no fill, no labels
 ShapeFeatureStyle riverStyle = new ShapeFeatureStyle()
         .strokeColor(new Color(0x6B9FD4))
         .strokeWidth(0.8f);

 // Lakes — filled blue polygons with a slightly darker border
 ShapeFeatureStyle lakeStyle = new ShapeFeatureStyle()
         .fillColor(new Color(0x6B9FD4))
         .strokeColor(new Color(0x4A7FB5))
         .strokeWidth(0.5f)
         .labelField("name");

 // Urban areas — semi-transparent fill, no border
 ShapeFeatureStyle urbanStyle = new ShapeFeatureStyle()
         .fillColor(new Color(180, 120, 80, 120))
         .strokeColor(null);

    • ShapeFeatureStyle

  • Method Details

    • fillColor

      public ShapeFeatureStyle fillColor(Color fillColor)
      Sets the fill color for polygon features.

      Pass null to skip polygon filling (outline only). The fill color may include an alpha channel for semi-transparent overlays: new Color(r, g, b, alpha).

      Parameters:
      fillColor - fill color, or null for no fill
      Returns:
      this style, for chaining

    • strokeColor

      public ShapeFeatureStyle strokeColor(Color strokeColor)
      Sets the stroke color for polygon outlines and polylines.

      Pass null to suppress stroking entirely. For polygons with a fill but no border, pass null here and set fillColor(Color).

      Parameters:
      strokeColor - stroke color, or null for no stroke
      Returns:
      this style, for chaining

    • strokeWidth

      public ShapeFeatureStyle strokeWidth(float strokeWidth)
      Sets the stroke width in points for polygon outlines and polylines.
      Parameters:
      strokeWidth - stroke width; clamped to a minimum of 0.1
      Returns:
      this style, for chaining

    • pointColor

      public ShapeFeatureStyle pointColor(Color pointColor)

      Parameters:
      pointColor - point color; must not be null
      Returns:
      this style, for chaining

    • pointRadius

      public ShapeFeatureStyle pointRadius(double pointRadius)

      Returns:
      this style, for chaining

    • labelField

      public ShapeFeatureStyle labelField(String labelField)
      Sets the .dbf field name whose value is drawn as a label next to each feature.

      Pass null to suppress labels. The field name is case-sensitive and must match a column in the shapefile's .dbf table. Common values for Natural Earth data: "name", "NAME", "name_en".

      Parameters:
      labelField - field name to use for labels, or null
      Returns:
      this style, for chaining

    • labelColor

      public ShapeFeatureStyle labelColor(Color labelColor)
      Sets the color used to draw feature labels.
      Parameters:
      labelColor - label color; must not be null
      Returns:
      this style, for chaining

    • tooltipFields

      public ShapeFeatureStyle tooltipFields(String... fields)
      Sets the .dbf field names whose values appear in the mouse-over feedback tooltip, in the order given.

      Replaces any previously configured tooltip fields. Pass no arguments (or call with an empty array) to clear tooltip fields. Example:

      
 new ShapeFeatureStyle()
         .fillColor(new Color(0x6B9FD4))
         .tooltipFields("name", "scalerank");
      Parameters:
      fields - zero or more .dbf field names (case-sensitive)
      Returns:
      this style, for chaining

      Returns:
      this style, for chaining
